title: Fermi-Dirac / Bose-Einstein integrals as polylogarithms
expression_sketch: F_s(x) = 1/gamma(s+1) * Integral(t**s / (exp(t-x)+1), (t, 0, oo)) = -polylog(s+1, -exp(x));  G_s(x) = 1/gamma(s+1) * Integral(t**s / (exp(t-x)-1), (t, 0, oo)) = polylog(s+1, exp(x))
latent_structure: One-parameter family of Fermi/Bose integrals is the polylogarithm evaluated at ±exp(x). Master object Li_{s+1}. Also the recurrence dF_s/dx = F_{s-1} (Wikipedia complete Fermi-Dirac integral) makes a derivative family. Not CSE of the integrand.

function_domains.gamma: Gamma(s+1) for s>-1 so Re(s+1)>0 (DLMF 5.2.1 Euler integral; here s>-1 is written)
function_domains.polylog: Li_s(z)=Sum_{n>=1} z^n/n^s analytic for |z|<1; |z|=1 if Re s>1; otherwise analytic continuation (DLMF 25.12.10 paragraph)

positivity_conditions.label: DECLARED
positivity_conditions.source: DLMF 25.12.14: s > −1 written under the Fermi-Dirac integral

positivity_conditions.statement: s > -1 and x < 0, or s > 0 and x <= 0, for G_s(x)
positivity_conditions.label: DECLARED

analytic_domains.statement: Fermi-Dirac integral F_s(x) defined for s>-1 (x real)
analytic_domains.label: DECLARED

analytic_domains.statement: Bose-Einstein integral G_s(x) defined for (s>-1 and x<0) or (s>0 and x<=0)
analytic_domains.label: DECLARED

analytic_domains.statement: principal branch of Li: cut on [1,oo) as for Li_2 in 25.12(i); 25.12.16 uses continuation
analytic_domains.label: DECLARED
analytic_domains.source: DLMF 25.12.10 analytic continuation sentence; Li_2 cut [1,oo) in 25.12.2

branch_conventions: principal polylog; for F_s, argument -exp(x) in (-oo,0] when x real, off the cut [1,oo)
for G_s with x<0, exp(x) in (0,1), inside the series disk
source_provenance: Wikipedia Complete Fermi-Dirac integral (matches DLMF, j>-1) https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Complete_Fermi%E2%80%93Dirac_integral

derived_conditions.statement: Gamma(s+1) has no poles for s>-1
derived_conditions.label: DERIVED
derived_conditions.source: Gamma poles at nonpositive integers; s+1>0

why_not_cse_lgg: The integral kernel 1/(e^{t-x}±1) is rewritten as a polylog. That is a named special-function family, not a common subexpression. Parameter s makes an R1 family.
proposer_leak_risk: Fermi-Dirac / Bose-Einstein / polylog names are in the source title. Proposer context should keep the integral vs Li equality without gold compact names. polylog and Integral are not in PARSE_POLICY; series form Sum((-exp(x))**n / n**(s+1), (n,1,oo)) is writable for x<0.
notes: 25.12.16 does not restated the (s,x) domain on the equation line; the domains are those of 25.12.14–15 plus polylog continuation 25.12.10, same subsection/section. Wikipedia F_0(x)=ln(1+exp(x)) is the s=0 closed form (j>-1 for the integral definition). T>0 is not used.
